sources.entry: b1gMail - Complete email solution that runs on any webspace with PHP and MariaDB. It supports POP3 catchall mailboxes and can also integrate with Postfix or b1gMailServer if you're running your own server. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: b1gMailServer
summary.one_liner: b1gMailServer is a custom mail server add-on for the b1gMail email portal, providing POP3, IMAP and SMTP services, now licensed under GPLv2.
use_cases: Running a hosted email service on b1gMail
Letting users sync mail with desktop and mobile clients
Acting as MX server for your own domains
Enforcing per-group send limits and access permissions
Adding spam protection to a self-hosted mail server
summary.what_it_does: b1gMailServer provides POP3, IMAP and SMTP access so users can read and send mail with most email clients, and its SMTP server can act as an MX server for incoming mail. The IMAP service supports folder synchronization across devices, IDLE-based push notifications, and QUOTA. Anti-spam measures include DNSBL checks, greylisting, SPF checks, and signature/disclaimer appending. Administration is done through a web interface integrated into b1gMail's control panel, where POP3, IMAP and SMTP access and send limits can be set per user group. AutoDiscover and AutoConfig let clients like Outlook and Thunderbird set up accounts from just an address and password.
notable: Licensed under GPLv2 since 2023, with source on GitHub
IMAP push via IDLE and full folder/flag sync with b1gMail
AutoDiscover and AutoConfig for easy client setup
Per-user-group permissions and send frequency limits
caveats: Designed to work with b1gMail; it is an add-on rather than a standalone mail server
Previously sold as a commercial product in two editions
Some features such as premium-only access require the separate PremiumAccount plugin
